summary:
The 10-Day Greece & Turkey Cruise begins with a journey through mainland Greece before shifting to three nights at sea in the Aegean. Explore Athens, ancient Olympia and Delphi, then travel to Meteora and its historic monasteries before boarding the cruise. The sailing calls at Mykonos, Kusadasi, Patmos, Crete and Santorini, with the Turkish port adding a different cultural dimension to the predominantly Greek route.
The program runs from April to October in line with scheduled cruise departures. It covers selected 4-star hotels with breakfast, a 3-night full-board cruise, English-speaking local guides, transfers and the sightseeing specified in the itinerary.

itinerary.title: Tuesday: Arrival to Athens
itinerary.text:
Arrival at Athens International Airport. Meet and transfer to your hotel in Athens.
Check-in after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Wednesday: Half Day Athens City Tour
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel.
Enjoy a half-day guided tour of Athens, including the Acropolis of Athens, Acropolis Museum, and Parthenon. Continue past the Parliament, Tomb of the Unknown Soldier, Presidential Palace, Panathenaic Stadium, Temple of Olympian Zeus, and Arch of Hadrian. Afternoon at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Thursday: Athens to Nauplia
itinerary.text:
Depart via the coastal road with a short stop at the Corinth Canal.
Continue to Ancient Theatre of Epidaurus, famous for its remarkable acoustics.
Short stop at Nafplio before visiting Mycenae and the Tomb of Agamemnon.
Drive through the central Peloponnese via Tripolis and Megalopolis to Olympia.
Overnight in Olympia.

itinerary.title: Friday: Olpmpia to Delphi
itinerary.text:
Morning visit to the Archaeological Site of Ancient Olympia. Including the Sanctuary of Olympian Zeus, Ancient Stadium and Archaeological Museum. Continue driving through the plains of Elis and Achaia and cross the Rio–Antirrio Bridge.
Pass through the towns of Nafpaktos and Itea before arriving in Delphi. Overnight in Delphi.

itinerary.title: Saturday: Delphi to Meteora
itinerary.text: Breakfast. Visit the Archaeological Site of Delphi and the Delphi Archaeological Museum. Continue to Kalambaka, located at the foot of the spectacular Meteora rock formations. Dinner and overnight in Kalambaka.

itinerary.title: Sunday: Meteora to Athens
itinerary.text: Visit Meteora and its famous monasteries built on towering rock formations. Continue to Athens via Trikala, Lamia, and Thermopylae with a stop at the Leonidas Monument. Arrival in Athens in the early evening. Overnight in Athens

itinerary.title: Monday: 3 Nights Cruise departs
itinerary.text:
Early morning transfer to Port of Piraeus. Embark on the 3-night Greek Islands and Turkey cruise.
First stop is Mykonos, famous for its sandy beaches, nightlife, Little Venice and iconic windmills.
Overnight on Board

itinerary.title: Tuesday: Kusadasi and Patmos
itinerary.text: Arrival at Kusadasi with an optional excursion to Ephesus to explore its ancient Roman ruins and historical landmarks. In the afternoon, arrive at Patmos with optional visits to the Monastery of Saint John the Theologian and the Cave of the Apocalypse.

itinerary.title: Wednesday: Crete and Santorini
itinerary.text:
Arrival at Heraklion with an optional excursion to the Palace of Knossos and other Minoan Civilization sites.
Continue sailing to Santorini, famous for its volcanic scenery and spectacular views.

itinerary.title: Thursday: Piraeus Port to Athens Airport
itinerary.text:
Early morning arrival at Port of Piraeus.
Breakfast on board and disembarkation. Transfer to the airport for your departure flight.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the Greece Turkey Cruise Package?
faqs.a: The Greece Turkey Cruise Package covers Athens, Mykonos, Santorini, Naxos, Crete, Rhodes, Kusadasi, Delphi, Olympia, and Meteora. This comprehensive itinerary combines Greece's most famous islands, important archaeological sites, spectacular monasteries, and a visit to Turkey's Aegean coast. The tour runs for 9 nights and 10 days.

faqs.q: How much does the Greece Turkey Cruise Package cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €2,575 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, cruise transportation, guided sightseeing tours, entrance fees according to the itinerary, selected meals, and all airport, hotel, and port transfers specified in the package. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates, cabin category, and availability.

faqs.q: Is cruise transportation between the destinations included?
faqs.a: Yes, cruise transportation between Athens, the Greek Islands, and Kusadasi is included according to the itinerary. The cruise provides a comfortable and scenic way to explore multiple destinations while enjoying the beauty of the Aegean Sea.

faqs.q: Are international flights included in the package?
faqs.a: No, international flights are not included in the tour price. Travelers are responsible for arranging their own flights to and from Greece. Magnificent Travel can assist with travel planning and recommendations if required.

faqs.q: Does the Greece Turkey Cruise Package include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides are included during the scheduled sightseeing tours. Your guides provide historical insights, cultural information, and local expertise throughout the journey.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Greece and Turkey?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors who want a comprehensive introduction to both Greece and Turkey. It combines famous islands, ancient archaeological sites, religious landmarks, beautiful coastlines, and cultural treasures in a single itinerary.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites, monastery complexes, island villages, historic districts, and cruise ports. Meteora and some ancient sites involve stairs and uneven surfaces, but most travelers in average health can comfortably participate.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Delphi, Olympia, Meteora, and Kusadasi?
faqs.a: Delphi was considered the spiritual center of the ancient Greek world and is home to the Sanctuary of Apollo. Olympia is the birthplace of the Olympic Games. Meteora is famous for its breathtaking monasteries perched atop towering rock formations. Kusadasi serves as the gateway to Ephesus, one of the best-preserved ancient cities in the Mediterranean region.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the Greece Turkey Cruise Package?
faqs.a: Free cancellation is available up to 90 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 90 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms, cruise conditions, and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Is the Greece Turkey Cruise Package available all year and can it be customized?
faqs.a: The cruise operates seasonally according to cruise schedules and weather conditions. You can extend your stay in Athens, add additional island nights, upgrade accommodation, include optional excursions, or customize the itinerary according to your preferences. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
